dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: How dare you slander Lord Starsnatcher in the presence of his followers? You, you...

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: ...Hmph. A follower of an adeptus must not swear. What's more, I am wearing His Lordship's mask.

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: Leave. Leave now. I do not wish to speak to you. Aye, you must be a fake yourself, you fake!
